name: The Jester
wisdomRoot: The holy fool — heyoka, the jester who alone may tell the truth. Chesterton: angels can fly because they take themselves lightly.
bio: The one who makes everything lighter just by arriving. Says the ridiculous thing first so everyone else can too.
sceneStory: At the bottom of a deep, dark canyon, a figure throws their head back mid-laugh. Everything loose around them is lifting off the canyon floor with them — stones, dust, their own feet — the whole hollow rising toward a bright slot of sky far above.
assignments: Add some chaos. The good kind.
